_comment: Разметка для слов из my_vocab.txt, которых нет в words.json: категория (c), модуль тату-курса (m), пример (ex). Ключ — английское слово в нижнем регистре без транскрипции. Раздел aliases склеивает варианты написания с существующими словами. Раздел fill дописывает пропущенные поля в словах из words.json.

save.ex: I save money for a new machine.

wipe.ex: I wipe the skin with green soap.

thin.ex: I need a thin line here.

table.ex: Put your bag on the table, please.

ancient.ex: The Ancient is the main building in Dota.

can.ex: I can do it next week.

should.ex: You should wash it twice a day.

will.ex: It will heal in two weeks.

need.ex: You need to sign the consent form.

ought to.ex: You ought to rest after a long session.

at the moment.ex: I am doing the outline at the moment.

from time to time.ex: From time to time I take a break.

transform.ex: I can transform your old tattoo.

inner part.ex: The inner part of the arm is sensitive.

outer part.ex: The outer part of the arm is easier.

black and grey.ex: I usually work in black and grey.

refund.ex: The deposit is non-refundable, so no refund.
